{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Read the trial data
trial_df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Check for duplicates in patient_id and sample_seq
print("Unique patient_id count:", trial_df['patient_id'].nunique())
print("Total rows:", len(trial_df))

# Identify the row with the highest sample_seq per patient
trial_df = trial_df.loc[trial_df.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].idxmax()]

# Now verify we have one row per patient
print("After deduplication, unique patient_id count:", trial_df['patient_id'].nunique())
print("Final number of rows:", len(trial_df))"}
